title: Standardised death rates by cause
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, three-year averages of age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants, both sexes and all ages. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A regional rate is a three-year average, so a single exceptional year is smoothed rather than visible.

title: Population density
description: Population density across European regions, expressed as inhabitants per square kilometre.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat demo_r_d3dens. Population density is population divided by regional area. The normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3, and each level carries the values Eurostat publishes for it rather than values derived from another level. Coverage follows the contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la densita di popolazione piu alta?
caveats: Annual regional density is not a real-time population count.

indicator.name: Population density
indicator.description: Annual population density of the region.

title: Population structure and ageing
description: Demographic structure indicators for European regions: median age, dependency ratios and the shares of each age group in the resident population.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat demo_r_pjanind3. Every demographic indicator the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset, and each one carries the unit Eurostat publishes it in — median ages in years, ratios and shares as percentages — read from the response rather than assumed. The normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, and each level carries the values Eurostat publishes for it rather than values derived from another level, which matters here because a median cannot be aggregated from its parts.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la popolazione piu anziana?
Dove e piu alto l'indice di dipendenza degli anziani?
caveats: Median age is not the arithmetic mean age.
Indicators of this table are published in different units; each one states its own.

title: Regional gross domestic product
description: Regional GDP measured the several ways Eurostat publishes it: in euro and in purchasing power standards, per inhabitant and in total, and as an index of the EU27 average.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat nama_10r_2gdp. Each unit the table publishes becomes an indicator, because they are different measures of the same aggregate rather than the same measure repeated: a total in millions and a value per inhabitant do not compare across regions of different size. National currency is not published here, because a value in national currency is not comparable between countries.

example_questions: Quali regioni hanno il PIL pro capite piu alto rispetto alla media UE?
caveats: Totals and per-inhabitant values are not comparable with each other across regions.
The EU27 index is a relative measure where the average equals 100, not a currency amount.

title: Unemployment rate by education
description: Annual regional unemployment rate for people aged 15 to 74, in total and by the level of education attained.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tgs00010, both sexes, ages 15 to 74. Each level of educational attainment the table publishes becomes an indicator, so a region's overall rate can be read beside the rates of the groups it is made of. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Dove e piu alta la disoccupazione regionale in Europa?
Come cambia la disoccupazione con il titolo di studio?
caveats: The rate covers people aged 15-74 and is an annual survey estimate.
Rates by education rest on smaller samples than the overall rate.

title: Population change and its components
description: Crude rates of regional population change, split into the natural change of the population and net migration.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tgs00099. The table publishes total change together with the two components it is made of — natural change and net migration plus statistical adjustment — and each becomes an indicator, so a region losing population can be read for why. All three are crude rates per 1 000 inhabitants.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee stanno perdendo popolazione?
Dove la crescita dipende dalla migrazione piuttosto che dalle nascite?
caveats: The values are crude annual rates per 1,000 inhabitants, not absolute counts.
Net migration is computed as a residual and absorbs statistical adjustments.

title: Nights spent in tourist accommodation
description: Annual nights spent by residents and non-residents in tourist accommodation, by type of establishment.
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat tour_occ_nin2, residents and non-residents together. Each type of accommodation the table publishes becomes an indicator, hotels and campsites beside the total they belong to. The normaliser keeps every code of the NUTS 2024 geography contract at the levels this dataset declares, NUTS 2 and NUTS 3, and each level carries the values Eurostat publishes for it rather than values derived from another level.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee registrano piu notti turistiche?
Dove pesano di piu i campeggi rispetto agli alberghi?
caveats: Counts cover reported tourist accommodation establishments, not all visitor nights.
A count is not comparable between regions of very different size.
